title: [DDV KATEHEZE] Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again? - Father Sebastian Šujević

reels.title: He summoned spirits and dropped blood. Then he couldn't sleep anymore
reels.hook: One drop of blood turned his life upside down
reels.why: A suspenseful story with a clear plot (old house, notebook, blood on the candle) and resolution, and already the first sentence carries a hook. It ends with a powerful point about the power of confession.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: So, one confession, how many wonderful things it contains within itself.

cards.text: One drop of blood turned his life upside down
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
At a spiritual retreat, the priest met an exhausted young man who couldn't sleep.
Old house, site of the séance
And at that moment his life changed.
One confession, how many wonderful things it contains within itself.
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?

reels.title: Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?
reels.hook: You go to confession, and you know you will fall again?
reels.why: Directly answers the question from the episode title, which a large number of believers ask themselves. It has a clear turn: the problem is not in falling, but in going alone.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: If you go alone, of course you will make a mistake and fall again, but that is not the point.

cards.text: You go to confession, and you know you will fall again?
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
The priest responds to an excuse he often hears from people who come to him.
If you go alone, of course you will make a mistake and fall again, but that is not the point.
“When I am weak, then I am strong.” – Saint Paul
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?

reels.title: Coffee, university, rain, line… Why something always pops up before confession
reels.hook: You decide to go to confession and just then everything pops up
reels.why: A funny and recognizable list of excuses in which everyone finds themselves, with an unexpected twist: obstacles are a sign that the moment is right.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: Well, that is a good sign, it means that this is the right moment for the encounter between you and the Heavenly Father.

cards.text: You decide to go to confession and just then everything pops up
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
The priest describes what happens between the decision and arriving at confession.
Oh, not today, look, it's raining.
Well, that is a good sign, it means that this is the right moment for the encounter between you and the Heavenly Father.
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?

reels.title: Scrolling, dopamine, then emptiness: do you really hate your sins?
reels.hook: Dopamine, scrolling… and in the end emptiness
reels.why: A concrete and very contemporary example (mobile phone addiction) with the humorous, candid phrase “lousy mobile phone”. Provides practical insight into the false sweetness of sin.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: But you take that lousy mobile phone again.

cards.text: Dopamine, scrolling… and in the end emptiness
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
In the act of contrition we pray: “I hate all my sins.”
But you take that lousy mobile phone again.
Well this is really stupid.
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?

reels.title: A penance that brought tears and freedom to a student from Rijeka
reels.hook: He received a simple penance. He broke into tears.
reels.why: A personal and emotional story with a concrete location and detail (Zamet, Psalm 103). It traverses the journey from being “fed up with the same sins” to freedom.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: Tears in the eyes, warmth in the heart, and finally freedom.

cards.text: He received a simple penance. He broke into tears.
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
Zamet, Rijeka
He was a first-year student at confession for youth.
Penance: Psalm 103
Tears in the eyes, warmth in the heart, and finally freedom.
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?

reels.title: Robe, ring, and sandals: what God gives you in confession
reels.hook: This is how God welcomes you in the confessional
reels.why: Strong and vivid images from the parable (embrace, robe, ring, sandals) explained simply and applied to the viewer.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: That is how God waits for you in the confessional.

cards.text: This is how God welcomes you in the confessional
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
The Parable of the Merciful Father: the younger son returns home after having squandered everything.
That is how God waits for you in the confessional.
Restores to him the identity of a free child of God.
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?

reels.title: Confession demands something that is not easy: to forgive
reels.hook: Confession demands something difficult from you
reels.why: Practical and challenging advice: to forgive others and ask for forgiveness in person. Ends with the clear message “There is none without forgiveness”.
reels.speaker: Sebastian Šujević
reels.quote: It is not easy, but after that you are a stronger person.

cards.text: Confession demands something difficult from you
Father Sebastian Šujević, priest
The priest lists the steps that help for a good confession.
Forgive me, I really made a mistake there.
It is not easy, but after that you are a stronger person.
Why Go to Confession If You Will Sin Again?
